signature: SUBROUTINE ZTPTRI( UPLO, DIAG, N, AP, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: diag
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: A is non-unit triangular;
-   `= 'U'`: A is unit triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: On entry, the upper or lower triangular matrix A, stored columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, AP($i + (j-1) \, ((2 \, n-j)/2) = A(i,j)$ for $j \le i \le n$. See below for further details. On exit, the (triangular) inverse of the original matrix, in the same packed storage format.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, A(i,i) is exactly zero.  The triangular matrix is singular and its inverse can not be computed.
